questions.question: Which of the following IP addresses is a private IP address?
questions.explanation: 192.168.0.0 to 192.168.255.255 is a reserved private IP address block.

questions.question: What port does HTTPS use by default?
questions.explanation: HTTPS traffic uses port 443 by default for secure communication.

questions.question: Which protocol is responsible for resolving domain names to IP addresses?
questions.explanation: DNS (Domain Name System) translates human-readable domain names to IP addresses.

title: Windows Commands
description: Check your Windows command line skills.

questions.question: Which command displays the IP configuration on Windows?
questions.explanation: ipconfig is the Windows command for IP configuration (ifconfig is for Linux/Unix).
